name: Gemini Code Assist
tagline: Google's coding assistant whose GitHub app auto-reviews pull requests with severity-ranked comments and committable fixes.
pricing: GitHub PR review app free in preview (quota of at least 100 reviews/day per installation); Code Assist Standard $19/user/mo annual ($22.80 monthly), Enterprise $45 ($54 monthly); individual free tier phasing out from June 2026
selfHostedNote: Google-hosted; an enterprise code review variant (Preview) supports GitHub Enterprise Cloud/Server sources via Google Cloud.
modelControl: Fixed Google Gemini models; no BYOK or model choice

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Pulls repository information for review context; no documented multi-repo or ticket context.

02-rule-centric.note: Custom style guides and a severity threshold config; default posture reviews every PR verbosely.

03-dual-workflow.note: IDE assistant (VS Code, JetBrains) plus the GitHub PR review bot cover local and PR surfaces.

04-business-logic.note: No issue-tracker integration or requirements validation documented.

05-continuous-learning.note: No documented learning from review feedback; config and style guides are static.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No sandbox execution or runtime validation of suggestions.

07-economic-transparency.note: Gemini models only with no BYOK; the GitHub app itself is free in preview.

08-actionability.note: Review comments include severity levels and suggested code fixes committable directly from GitHub.

09-measurable-roi.note: No documented review analytics or ROI reporting for the GitHub app.
